cases.name: A-cases-quantity
cases.promptMarkdown:
Write test cases for the user story below.

Story CART-12: Change the quantity of an item in the cart

As a shopper, I want to change how many of an item are in my cart, so that I buy the amount I need.

- AC-1: The quantity field accepts whole numbers from 1 to 20.
- AC-2: Setting the quantity to 0 asks "Remove this item?" and removes the item only when the shopper confirms.
- AC-3: A quantity above 20 shows "You can buy at most 20 of this item." and keeps the previous quantity.

Where information is missing, state your assumption and continue; do not ask questions. Reply with the deliverable only, as Markdown, starting at its first line, with no introduction and no code fence around it. Do not create or edit files.

config.pattern: ^(?=[\s\S]*(?:\bAC[- ]?0?1\b|(?:valid|accept\w*|updates? to|success\w*|saved?)[^\n]{0,80}(?<![\d.])(?:1|20)(?![\d.])|(?<![\d.])(?:1|20)(?![\d.])[^\n]{0,80}(?:valid|accept\w*|success\w*|saved)))(?=[\s\S]*(?:\bAC[- ]?0?2\b|Remove this item\?))(?=[\s\S]*(?:\bAC[- ]?0?3\b|You can buy at most 20 of this item))
